thread:
Maya: heads-up — nightly retrieval eval shows a big quality spike for customer_silo_17, weird low rerank NDCG and lots of hallucinated answers. :eyes:
Sam: seeing this too, topk recall dropped on that cohort only. overall prod cohort stable. link: https://internal/evals/1938456789
Jordan: any infra changes overnight? index rebuilds, quant jobs?
Maya: we rolled quant-4bit for embedder v2 on dedicated yesterday at 02:14 UTC (commit: 9f3a7b), and ran a bulk index rebuild for silo_*. logs attached below.
Priya: hmm could be quantization noise re: embedding space. can we repro on a small sample?
EvalBot: nightly-eval-run completed (run_id: ne-20260320-07). summary: mean_cosine(silo_17) 0.61 (baseline 0.86), topk@10 recall 0.64 (baseline 0.91).
Sam: thanks. quick repro:
```
python tools/eval_retrieval.py --cohort silo_17 --model embed-v2-quant4 --topk 10 --sample 500
```
Sam: output shows many nearest neighbors are OOD docs, distance variance doubled.
Jordan: can you rerun with float16 weights (no quant) on same sample? to isolate quant effect.
Maya: started float16 run now. Also cross-check: we rolled a tiny reranker tweak (softmax temp 0.95 -> 0.9) in canary last week but that shouldn't hit silo_17 (routing policy excludes). commit 4b2e1c.
Priya: if float16 fixes it, plan = revert quant for embed-v2 in dedicated and reindex silo_17. if not, look at reranker change + candidate set mismatch after rebuild.
EvalBot: float16 sample run done: mean_cosine(silo_17) 0.84, topk@10 recall 0.90.
Maya: ok that strongly implicates quant. create rollback PR for quantized embedder on dedicated and schedule incremental reindex for silo_17.
Sam: opened PR #1423 (revert quant for embed-v2 on dedicated). tagging infra and deploy. @Priya can you own reindex job?
Priya: on it. will run incremental reindex starting in 10m, will monitor eval metrics and paste progress here.
Jordan: also file a postmortem note linking the quant experiment config, dataset slice, and eval diffs so we don't reapply blindly.
Maya: agreed. I'll add a short eval checklist and a canary matrix for future quant experiments (include mean_cosine per-cohort threshold).
Priya: incremental reindex progress: 10% done, sampling checks look good so far.
Sam: :thumbsup: keep updates brief here and we'll escalate if anything else pops up.
